title: FIPS Cryptographic Inventory Entry
description: Schema for a single cryptographic call-site entry in the FIPS 140-3 readiness inventory (FIPS-CRYPTO-001). Shared across all Phase 1 cryptographic-discovery work orders (WO-005..WO-011) and consumed by the aggregate inventory produced in WO-019.

file.description: Repository-relative path to the source file containing the call site.

line.description: Primary (starting) line number of the call site, declaration, or import in `file`.

line_end.description: Optional closing line number when the entry spans a range (e.g. a function body or multi-line const block). Omitted for single-line entries.

function.description: Enclosing function/method name (Go receiver.Method or Function), or a descriptive context such as 'package imports', 'package-level const', or 'Core struct field' when the call site is not inside a function body.

algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm/primitive/parameter involved (e.g. 'AES-256-GCM', 'ECDSA P-256', 'constant-time comparison', 'Shamir Secret Sharing (GF(256))'). Use 'N/A' for entries that are purely structural (e.g. an import line with no direct algorithm binding).

library.description: Go import path(s) or package(s) providing the primitive (e.g. 'crypto/aes + crypto/cipher', 'github.com/hashicorp/go-kms-wrapping/v2', 'github.com/hashicorp/vault/shamir').

module_boundary.description: Classification of which side of the cryptographic module boundary this call site occupies, per FIPS-CRYPTO-001.

security_relevant.description: True if the call site affects confidentiality, integrity, authentication, or key/secret management.

fips_approved.description: True if the algorithm/primitive itself is FIPS 140-3 approved per SP 800-140C (e.g. AES-GCM, ECDSA on an approved curve, SHA-2 based TLS cipher suites). False for non-approved algorithms (e.g. Shamir Secret Sharing). This reflects algorithm-level approval status only; it does NOT assert that the specific Go binary/build in this repository has completed CMVP module validation - that is addressed by later FIPS phases (validated module boundary).

notes.description: Free-text context: what the call site does, cross-references to related call sites/files, and any caveats (e.g. provider-dependent FIPS status, known gaps).

context.description: Optional classification of the call-site kind.
